subject.title: fix(acpx): keep leaked non-openai model out of the Codex ACP thinking slot

question: Should OpenClaw accept this Codex ACP compatibility policy: drop unsupported inherited defaults at spawn, fail explicit unsupported model selections, and expose optional model provenance/effective-model fields on the ACP runtime contract?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound, but it deliberately changes model-routing and plugin runtime contract behavior in a compatibility-sensitive auth/provider area, which needs owner approval rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Accept provenance-aware policy
options.body: Approve the current behavior and clear the stale requested-changes review so this P1 candidate fix can proceed through normal merge gates.

options.title: Require contract hardening first
options.body: Ask for additional ACP runtime contract documentation or cross-backend compatibility tests before merge.

options.title: Pause for owner redesign
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers do not want core ACP contracts widened for backend-specific effective-model reporting.

recommendation.title: Accept provenance-aware policy
recommendation.body: Approve the current behavior and clear the stale requested-changes review so this P1 candidate fix can proceed through normal merge gates.
